name: HOLLOW PINES
text: An asylum at night with a flashlight. The patient only moves when your light is off him, and every blink brings him nearer.

name: VESPER WARD
text: Three fuses to find for the lift. A woman who hunts, a pale one who nears in the dark, a brute at the end; a pistol, a shotgun and a machine gun to find, load and upgrade.

name: DEAD END
text: Sixty seconds to hide in a family's house in a storm. Then a thin pale thing comes in that hears you, sees your torch and remembers where you hid before.

name: EYES DOWN
text: New York 1985, a studio on the 31st floor, five nights of chores. Black slime things wait where the chores make you look. Meet an eye and it hunts.

name: THE SPECKLED BAND
text: You are Sherlock Holmes. The book's own words run while you do as he did; do otherwise and the others answer you.

name: RAMEN
text: A one-person ramen cart on East 1st Street, Friday 4 October 1985. Light the burners, cook every bowl by hand, take cash, and keep the regulars through one day and one night.

name: THE LAST CHANCE
text: A saloon in Perdition, Arizona Territory, 1881. Seven open nights behind the bar: pour, make change, hear sixteen people's secrets, and see who is alive on Sunday.

name: MIDNIGHT CRUMBS
text: A mouse's secret diner inside the kitchen wall. Cook for twenty-eight regulars who talk back, and mind the cat.

name: THE CANTINA
text: A two-storey bar of strange regulars, with card tables and a jukebox.

name: STADIUM JAM
text: Guitar or drums in front of a full stadium. Up to eight in a room by a code.

name: THE GARAGE
text: A real drum kit in a garage on a street that lives. Free play, fifteen lessons, neighbours who hear how you play, and a shotgun on the back wall.

name: SHARDWAVE
text: Cut each shard with the matching blade the way its arrow points. Three tracks, or your own audio file.

name: SKY ACES
text: Sixteen aircraft from a Sopwith Camel to an F-22 over a wild island of mountains and forest, each with a working cockpit. Guns, rockets, waves of bandits.

name: HALCYON GREENS
text: One hole in a misty meadow at dusk, with a stream and a waterfall.

name: COLD BORE
text: Five contracts with a bolt-action rifle and a scope you really look through. Rounds fly under drag, gravity and wind.

name: EDGE OF 88
text: A lift to floor 88 and a plank over the city at sunset.

name: HULL DOWN
text: A Challenger 2's turret: laser rangefinder, SABOT and HEAT, a thermal sight, damage that breaks tracks. Alone, or a lobby of up to four.

name: SWIVEL
text: A gunship's ball turret, made for a chair that spins. The ship flies itself; ships come from every side in waves and you turn and shoot.

name: SPACE FLEET
text: The battlefield floats in your room. Pick a navy, build ships, order them by hand and take the other mothership. Against the bot or one other player.

name: BREACHLINE
text: A two-player gun duel by a room code, with a practice mode against a bot.

name: AR DUEL
text: Your real room is the arena: slow shots you sidestep, duck or block, six weapons, best of three, a practice bot.

name: LASER TAG
text: Super Charge 25, one on one in a real room. Both players in passthrough with only the packs and guns drawn.

name: SENSOR TAG
text: A sensor on each chest, a pistol that fires one beam a second, ten lives. Turn away, duck, or cover the sensor with a hand.

name: SKIRMISH TABLE
text: Two players, or one against the computer and its campaign, a team each on a flagstone board in a dungeon (a moat of lava, cavern rock, a brick wall and its gate, ivy): pick your own team from fourteen kinds (fighters, casters, creatures, a captain) under a point budget, then one piece a turn, moved, used, then faced. Your units earn experience and upgrades. On your real table in passthrough, or on a screen, by a four-letter code.

name: JUNGLE COURT
text: A full-size court in a jungle clearing at night. Four balls on a rack, a 60 second game, rain and storms on a switch; shoot, dribble and dunk with your own hands.

name: SAVANO LANE NIGHT DRIVE
text: A true-scale 5 km of north Fort Worth and a 2021 Honda e in which everything works: power, gears, lights, signals, wipers, doors, the radio. Real roads, traffic that keeps the law, people on the pavements, the real sky by the hour. Drive alone, or share a room code to ride in one car or meet on the same roads.
